## Critique
- claim-1: The column enumeration, ten generator-Pieri rows, and three displayed minors are mathematically correct conditional on the asserted interval presentation. Each minor has determinant \(1\), so its rows span the complete degree-\(d+4\) column lattice. However, the strategy has not established that presentation in degree \(d+4\). In particular, accepted task 85 only covers \(k\le b=3\), whereas this calculation uses \(k=4\). Also, arbitrary \(A_+M\)-products are not literally all of the displayed form; one must prove that they are spanned by these rows using \(A_+=(h_1,\ldots,h_q)\) and the \(A\)-module structure of \(M\). Thus the requested target is established only conditionally, not unconditionally. The prohibition on higher-degree and minimality conclusions is respected.
- claim-2: This accurately identifies the decisive missing evidence. Without a precise invocation or proof of the degree-\(d+4\) interval basis and row-completeness statement, the unconditional target remains unresolved.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Prove
  \[
  M_{d+4}=\bigoplus_{\substack{i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1}\\|\mu|=d+4}}\mathbb Zs_\mu
  \]
  and
  \[
  (A_+M)_{d+4}=\sum_{\ell=1}^{4}h_\ell M_{d+4-\ell},
  \]
  including the reduction of arbitrary \(A_+M\)-products to the ten displayed generator-Pieri rows.
- [computation] Supply an executed exact partition/horizontal-strip checker for \((i,j)=(3,3),(3,4),(4,3)\) that enumerates all columns and rows, reproduces the three matrices, computes their determinants, and records code, output, exit status, and artifact digest.
- [source-refresh] Provide a stable source excerpt or accepted-project claim locator proving the integral interval presentation and completeness of the \(A_+\)-product rows specifically in degree \(d+4\).

## Required revisions
- Replace “every relevant homogeneous \(A_+\)-row has form” by the precise assertion that the displayed rows generate \((A_+M)_{d+4}\), with proof.
- Either invoke an established presentation valid at \(k=4\), or explicitly report that the requested target remains conditional and therefore is not fully established.
